Submitted with the locked **deviation** status.

Repair made: the convenience-termination insertion now makes "the Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI" operative (with a short identifier confirming the Company is the Customer, so the defined party is unchanged), curing the failed deterministic check. The three-months' Section 3.1 fee cap insertion is unchanged, Sections 4.1, 4.2(a) and (c) remain byte-for-byte intact, and no preferred-only terms were imported.
